name: Omission
author: NobleDoodle
description: A macOS-style overview for Omarchy: your own wallpaper, a frosted strip of spaces, and the active workspace's windows laid out exactly as they are tiled, handed over from and back to the desktop without a flash. Includes the dynamic bar spaces widget and a themed Alt-Tab switcher for the active workspace. Derived from Mission Control by Ryan Macy.

barWidget.description: Workspace buttons that follow Omission's dynamic spaces
